name: Dark Techy
note: Developer-tool identity: Oxanium (engineering display sans) over JetBrains Mono, cyan accent at hue 195 with cool-tinted neutrals, sharp corners, restrained single-layer shadows. The inverted-tone dark scheme lands near-black surfaces; keep lightness low and chroma cool. Don't warm the tint and don't go pill-radius — this style reads 'infrastructure', not 'friendly'.
